name: comp-359
title: Image Tooltip
description: An outlined button opens a rich tooltip that holds a wide image above a short title and paragraph. In the recording the popup is cropped, so only its lower edge and pointer are actually seen.
use: A small button should preview a picture and its caption on hover instead of linking away.
avoid: The popup is wide and can be clipped by a tight container or viewport edge, as in this recording.
a11y: The popup opens on focus and the image has alt text, but that text is only the generic word 'Content'. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A single outlined button reading 'W/ image' sits on a near-black page. On hover a light rounded tooltip begins to open above it, but the frame cuts it off so only its bottom strip and a downward pointer show.
behaves: Hovering or focusing the button opens the tooltip above it at once and moving away dismisses it. The recorded crop never reveals the popup's full body, only its lower edge.
customise: The image path, title and paragraph are written inside the tooltip and must be edited in the file; only the trigger label is separate.
weight: light: One button and a small popup; the image just loads, with no animation loop.
issues: The recorded crop cuts the tooltip off, so its image and text are never visible.
The image alt text is only the word 'Content'.
polishWhy: The popup is cropped out of every frame, so only the plain trigger button is really visible.

frames.note: The tooltip opens above the button but the crop cuts it off, leaving only its bottom strip and arrow visible.
